name: Shiva Granito Export Limited
about: Shiva Granito Export Limited engages in the manufacture and export of quartz stone slabs, various grades of resins, and quartz stone powder and statues. It offers mineral powders, artificial quartz slabs, chemicals, counter tops, marbles, granite, and porcelain slabs. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Shiva Exports Co. Shiva Granito Export Limited was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Udaipur, India.
